bands.label: Pre-A1
bands.title: Foundations
bands.description: First words, memorised phrases and recognition of a few familiar expressions.

listening: I can recognise a few very familiar everyday words and greetings when spoken slowly and clearly.
speaking: I can say single words and very short, memorised phrases (e.g. greetings, thanks).
reading: I can recognise a few familiar written words and signs (e.g. my name, 'exit').
writing: I can copy single words and write my name and address.
grammar: I can use a few fixed formulas without consciously controlling grammar.
vocabulary: I know a handful of basic words for immediate, concrete needs.
pronunciation: I can repeat isolated sounds and short words after a model.
interaction: I can respond with single words to very simple, slow questions with support.
mediation: I can pass on simple, memorised messages (e.g. a name or number) with help.

bands.label: A1
bands.title: Beginner
bands.description: Introduce yourself, talk about everyday life, family, home and plans.

listening: I can understand slow, clearly articulated speech about myself and my immediate surroundings.
speaking: I can use simple phrases to describe myself, where I live and people I know.
reading: I can understand very short, simple texts and find specific, predictable information.
writing: I can write simple sentences about myself (e.g. a postcard, a simple form).
grammar: I can use a few basic structures (to be, present simple, common prepositions) correctly.
vocabulary: I know basic words for everyday topics (family, home, food, time).
pronunciation: I can pronounce a limited set of learned words so they are mostly understood.
interaction: I can ask and answer simple questions in predictable, everyday situations.
mediation: I can convey simple information to another person using basic words.

bands.label: A2
bands.title: Elementary
bands.description: Past, future and common everyday situations.

listening: I can understand phrases and the most common vocabulary on familiar topics.
speaking: I can describe my background, routines and plans in simple connected sentences.
reading: I can read short, simple texts and find specific information in everyday material.
writing: I can write short, simple notes and messages about routine matters.
grammar: I can use past and future forms and common sentence patterns with reasonable accuracy.
vocabulary: I have enough words for routine transactions and familiar topics.
pronunciation: I can pronounce familiar words and phrases clearly enough to be generally understood.
interaction: I can handle simple, routine exchanges and brief social conversations.
mediation: I can pass on the main point of a short, simple message to someone else.

bands.label: A2+
bands.title: Elementary Plus
bands.description: A strong A2 with the beginnings of B1 features: more connected speech and interaction.

listening: I can follow the main points of clear, standard speech on familiar matters.
speaking: I can give simple, connected accounts and express basic preferences and plans.
reading: I can understand straightforward texts and identify the main conclusions.
writing: I can write a short, simple paragraph connecting several ideas with basic linkers.
grammar: I can combine tenses and structures to talk about past, present and future.
vocabulary: I have a wider everyday vocabulary and can paraphrase simple gaps.
pronunciation: I can speak with intelligible pronunciation and some awareness of stress.
interaction: I can enter unprepared into conversation on familiar topics, though I may hesitate.
mediation: I can relay the main information from simple material, asking for help when needed.

listening: I can understand the main points of clear standard speech on familiar matters in work, school and leisure.
speaking: I can give connected descriptions of experiences and briefly explain opinions and plans.
reading: I can understand texts on everyday topics and recognise the writer's main conclusions.
writing: I can write simple connected text on familiar topics and personal experiences.
grammar: I can use a range of structures with reasonable control, including some complex sentences.
vocabulary: I have enough vocabulary to express myself on most everyday topics, with some circumlocution.
pronunciation: I can speak with intelligible pronunciation, though a foreign accent is noticeable.
interaction: I can deal with most situations while travelling and enter unprepared into conversation on familiar topics.
mediation: I can summarise the main points of straightforward information and pass them on.

bands.label: B1+
bands.title: Intermediate Plus
bands.description: A strong B1 with the beginnings of B2: longer turns and more active discussion.

listening: I can follow the main ideas of extended speech and some discussions on concrete topics.
speaking: I can present a straightforward topic and support opinions with reasons and examples.
reading: I can read texts with some unfamiliar vocabulary and still follow the argument.
writing: I can write clearly connected text on a range of familiar subjects with appropriate register.
grammar: I can use a wider range of structures with growing accuracy, though errors persist under pressure.
vocabulary: I can handle less routine situations with a good range of vocabulary.
pronunciation: I can control stress and intonation enough to keep speech clearly intelligible.
interaction: I can take an active part in discussion and maintain conversation on familiar topics.
mediation: I can summarise and report the main content of spoken and written input.

listening: I can understand extended speech and complex lines of argument when the topic is reasonably familiar.
speaking: I can give clear, detailed descriptions and explain viewpoints with advantages and disadvantages.
reading: I can read articles and reports concerned with contemporary problems and follow arguments.
writing: I can write clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects, evaluating information and arguments.
grammar: I can control grammar well and use a variety of structures to express precise meaning.
vocabulary: I have a broad lexical range to express myself precisely, with only occasional gaps.
pronunciation: I can produce clear, natural pronunciation with good control of stress and intonation.
interaction: I can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction possible.
mediation: I can summarise information from different sources and reconstruct arguments coherently.

bands.label: B2+
bands.title: Upper-Intermediate Plus
bands.description: A strong B2 with the beginnings of C1: sustained argument and style control.

listening: I can follow the essentials of lectures, talks and reports on a wide range of topics.
speaking: I can develop an argument systematically, linking points logically and adapting style to purpose.
reading: I can understand complex texts and appreciate distinctions of style, tone and register.
writing: I can write well-structured, detailed text, synthesising information and arguments.
grammar: I can use complex structures flexibly with only occasional non-systematic errors.
vocabulary: I can express myself with precision and nuance, using idiomatic expressions naturally.
pronunciation: I can vary intonation and stress for emphasis with near-native clarity.
interaction: I can engage in extended discussion, responding and reformulating to keep interaction flowing.
mediation: I can convey the content and implications of complex material to different audiences.

listening: I can understand a wide range of demanding, longer speech and recognise implicit meaning.
speaking: I can express myself fluently and spontaneously, with little obvious searching for expressions.
reading: I can understand long, complex factual and literary texts and appreciate subtle distinctions of style.
writing: I can write clear, well-structured, detailed text on complex subjects, showing control of organisational patterns.
grammar: I can use grammar with a high degree of accuracy and control, choosing structures for effect.
vocabulary: I have a wide lexical repertoire, including idiomatic expressions, and can use them precisely.
pronunciation: I can produce clear, natural speech with effective use of stress, rhythm and intonation.
interaction: I can use the language flexibly and effectively for social and professional purposes.
mediation: I can summarise long, demanding texts and mediate concepts between speakers of different backgrounds.

listening: I can understand with ease virtually everything heard, including fast, colloquial and regional speech.
speaking: I can present clear, smoothly flowing descriptions and arguments in a style appropriate to context.
reading: I can read with ease virtually all forms of written language, including abstract and specialised texts.
writing: I can write clear, flowing, complex text in an appropriate and effective style with a logical structure.
grammar: I can use grammar with full, natural control and nuance, including subtle stylistic choices.
vocabulary: I have an essentially native-level lexical range, with precise, idiomatic and figurative language.
pronunciation: I can speak with native-like pronunciation, stress and intonation across registers.
interaction: I can take part effortlessly in any conversation, using idiomatic expressions and colloquialisms.
mediation: I can mediate effectively and discreetly, conveying nuance, register and implied meaning.
